name: token_bucket
agent_instructions:
Implement a token-bucket rate limiter in a NEW file rate_limiter.py.

Provide a class TokenBucket with exactly this interface:
  - __init__(self, capacity, refill_rate, now=0.0)
  - allow(self, tokens=1.0, now=None) -> bool   # now = current time in seconds; if None, reuse the bucket's last-known time

Behaviour requirements - ALL must hold:
  1. The bucket starts FULL (capacity tokens).
  2. Tokens refill continuously at refill_rate tokens/second based on the elapsed time since the last allow() call; the refilled level is CAPPED at capacity (never more).
  3. allow(t, now): first refill up to `now`, then if at least t tokens are available, deduct t and return True; otherwise deduct NOTHING and return False.
  4. Fractional tokens and fractional seconds must work.
  5. Time only moves forward: if `now` is earlier than the last time, treat the elapsed time as 0 (no refill, no error).
  6. allow(t) where t > capacity can never succeed.

Follow strict TDD: write pytest tests in test_rate_limiter.py covering every one of these rules FIRST, confirm they fail, then implement until they pass. Cover negative and boundary cases (zero tokens, t > capacity, time going backwards, exact-capacity drain).
